name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: A pest-control customer's decision usually comes down to two things: whether someone answers the phone and what their Google reviews say. I've spent the last two-plus years running that second piece for home-services clients at Solenzo, my own marketing-operations company, on top of 15 years managing customer accounts and CRM systems in SaaS and agency environments.

At Birdeye, I sold and onboarded partners directly on a reputation-management and local-listings platform, the same category of work behind keeping a company's Google reviews and business listings accurate. At Solenzo, I claim and optimize Google Business Profile listings and run automated review-generation sequences for electrical, plumbing, and HVAC clients, and I manage Google Ads accounts for that same book. I've worked inside HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel for years, keeping customer records and service-inquiry follow-up accurate across concurrent accounts.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that maps to the day-to-day at Atlus. I'm at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
